notes:
{営業|えいぎょう} covers three related meanings: running a business, sales work, and being open for business. It is one of the most common business-related words.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- No standard transitive pair
- Pattern: {営業|えいぎょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧

COMPOUNDS:
- {営業|えいぎょう}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: business hours
- {営業|えいぎょう}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧: open for business (sign)
- {営業|えいぎょう}⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧: sales department
- {営業|えいぎょう}マン: salesperson
- {営業|えいぎょう}⟦{所|しょ}→〜所：09844_sho⟧: sales office, branch
- {営業|えいぎょう}{日|び}: business day

USAGE:
As a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb, {営業|えいぎょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ can mean "to operate a business" or "to be open." When asking a store, {営業|えいぎょう}⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ means "Are you open?" In a corporate context, {営業|えいぎょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ means to go on a sales call.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{休業|きゅうぎょう}→休業：11541_kyuugyou⟧: closed for business (opposite)
- ⟦{商売|しょうばい}→商売：03239_shoubai⟧: trade, business (more informal, small-scale)
- ⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧: selling (focused on the transaction itself)
